# <span class="en">Emerging hot spot analysis</span><span class="zh">新兴热点分析</span> {#sec-ehsa}

::: {.en}
*Addresses RQ2.* The emerging hot spot analysis is carried out by
`scripts/04_ehsa.R`, with the statistic itself in `R/ehsa.R`. The section
builds the space-time cube, states the method, and then, before any result
is interpreted, checks the reference implementation against an independent
computation. That check changes the results substantially, so it is
presented in full.
:::

::: {.zh}
*对应 RQ2。* 新兴热点分析由 `scripts/04_ehsa.R` 完成,统计量本身见 `R/ehsa.R`。本节
先构建时空立方体、说明方法,然后在解读任何结果之前,先用一个独立计算来检验参照实现。
这一检验显著改变了结果,因此完整呈现。
:::

```{r}
#| label: ehsa-prep
#| include: false
cls_of <- function(v, which = "cls") ehsa_label(EH$results[[v]][[which]]$classification)
ehsa_df <- function(v) {
  r <- EH$results[[v]]
  tibble(TS_PCODE = EH$locs, cls = ehsa_label(r$cls$classification),
         tau = r$cls$tau, p_mk = r$cls$p_value,
         n_hot  = rowSums(r$p_fold <= EH$alpha & r$G > 0),
         n_cold = rowSums(r$p_fold <= EH$alpha & r$G < 0))
}
ec <- ehsa_df("conflict") |>
  left_join(st_drop_geometry(ts_an)[, c("TS_PCODE", "TS", "ST")], by = "TS_PCODE")
ec_sf <- ts_an |> select(TS_PCODE) |> left_join(ec, by = "TS_PCODE")
ncls <- function(d, k) sum(d$cls == k)
k_star <- min(EH$null_nq$k[EH$null_nq$surv_hot <= 0.01])
quarters <- EH$cube_info$periods
```

## <span class="en">Building the space-time cube</span><span class="zh">构建时空立方体</span> {#sec-ehsa-cube}

```{r}
#| label: ehsa-cube-code
#| eval: false
geo <- ts_an |> select(TS_PCODE)
geo$nb <- include_self(nb_an)      # assigned directly: dplyr >= 1.2 will not
geo$wt <- st_weights(geo$nb)       # accept an `nb` object inside mutate()

cube_q <- spacetime(as.data.frame(panel_q), geo,
                    .loc_col = "TS_PCODE", .time_col = "period")
is_spacetime_cube(cube_q)
```

::: {.en}
`spacetime()` binds the township-by-quarter panel to the geometry without
merging them, and `is_spacetime_cube()` confirms the cube is complete: every
one of the `r EH$cube_info$n_locs` townships appears exactly once in each of
the `r EH$cube_info$n_times` quarters, `r n_fmt(EH$cube_info$n_bins)` bins in
all. The neighbour list is attached to the geometry as a column, with each
township included in its own neighbourhood, as Gi\* requires. Two
practicalities are worth recording. dplyr 1.2 refuses an object of class `nb`
inside `mutate()`, so the column is assigned directly. And the geometry is
sorted by `TS_PCODE`, for the reason shown in @sec-ehsa-check.
:::

::: {.zh}
`spacetime()` 把镇区-季度面板与几何对象绑定在一起而不合并它们,`is_spacetime_cube()`
则确认立方体是完整的:`r EH$cube_info$n_locs` 个镇区中的每一个在 `r EH$cube_info$n_times`
个季度里都恰好出现一次,共 `r n_fmt(EH$cube_info$n_bins)` 个格元。邻居列表作为一列
附在几何对象上,每个镇区都包含在自己的邻域中,这是 Gi\* 的要求。有两个实际问题值得
记录:dplyr 1.2 不接受 `mutate()` 中类为 `nb` 的对象,所以这一列是直接赋值的;几何
对象按 `TS_PCODE` 排序,原因见 @sec-ehsa-check。
:::

## <span class="en">Space-time Gi\* and the Mann-Kendall test</span><span class="zh">时空 Gi\* 与 Mann-Kendall 检验</span> {#sec-ehsa-method}

::: {.en}
For township $i$ in quarter $t$, the space-time Gi\* pools the township and
its queen neighbours in quarter $t$ and, with a time lag of $k = 1$, the same
set in quarter $t-1$. Weights are row-standardised within each quarter's
copy. The statistic is standardised against the mean $\bar x_t$ and variance
$s_t^2$ of quarter $t$ alone:

$$
G^*_{it} = \frac{\sum_{s=t-k}^{t}\sum_j w_{ij} x_{js} \;-\; W_i \bar x_t}
{s_t \sqrt{\left(n S_{1i} - W_i^2\right)/(n-1)}},
\qquad W_i = \sum_{s,j} w_{ij}, \quad S_{1i} = \sum_{s,j} w_{ij}^2 .
$$

A township is a hot spot in a quarter if its neighbourhood total is
significantly larger than the neighbourhood totals of randomly chosen
townships *in the same quarter*. The standardisation by quarter is
deliberate: a national surge raises every township at once and does not, by
itself, make any township a hot spot.

Each township then has a series of `r EH$cube_info$n_times` Gi\* values, and
the Mann-Kendall test [@mann1945; @kendall1975] asks whether the series
trends up or down. The classification combines the two: which quarters
were significant hot or cold spots, in what sequence, and whether the trend
is significant. @tbl-classes summarises the rules, which follow Esri's
definitions [@esri_ehsa] as implemented in sfdep.
:::

::: {.zh}
对于第 $t$ 季度的镇区 $i$,时空 Gi\* 汇集该镇区及其 queen 邻居在第 $t$ 季度的值,
并在时间滞后 $k = 1$ 时,汇集同一组镇区在第 $t-1$ 季度的值。权重在每个季度的副本中
分别行标准化。统计量只以第 $t$ 季度自身的均值 $\bar x_t$ 与方差 $s_t^2$ 进行标准化
(公式见上)。

一个镇区在某季度为热点,意味着它的邻域总量显著大于**同一季度**随机选取的镇区的邻域
总量。按季度标准化是刻意为之:全国性的激增会同时抬高每一个镇区,其本身并不会使任何
镇区成为热点。

于是每个镇区有一条由 `r EH$cube_info$n_times` 个 Gi\* 值组成的序列,Mann-Kendall
检验 [@mann1945; @kendall1975] 判断该序列是否有上升或下降趋势。分类综合两者:哪些
季度是显著的热点或冷点、出现的顺序如何、趋势是否显著。@tbl-classes 概括了这些规则,
它们遵循 Esri 的定义 [@esri_ehsa],并按 sfdep 中的实现执行。
:::

```{r}
#| label: tbl-classes
#| tbl-cap: "<span class='en'>The emerging hot spot classes as sfdep implements them (cold classes mirror the hot ones). 'Significant' means the folded permutation p-value is at most 0.05.</span><span class='zh'>sfdep 实现的新兴热点类别(冷点类别与热点类别对称)。「显著」指折叠置换 p 值不超过 0.05。</span>"

tribble(
  ~Class, ~`Rule (hot version)`,
  "New",          "Significant hot in the final quarter only, never before",
  "Consecutive",  "An unbroken run of significant hot quarters at the end of the series, no significant hot quarter before it, and fewer than 90% of quarters hot",
  "Intensifying", "Significant hot in at least 90% of quarters including the last, with a significant upward trend",
  "Persistent",   "Significant hot in at least 90% of quarters, no significant trend",
  "Diminishing",  "Significant hot in at least 90% of quarters including the last, with a significant downward trend",
  "Sporadic",     "Significant hot in some quarters, fewer than 90%, never a significant cold spot",
  "Oscillating",  "Significant hot in the final quarter, significant cold in at least one earlier quarter",
  "Historical",   "Significant hot in at least 90% of quarters, but not hot in the last",
  "No pattern detected", "None of the above, typically never significant"
) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_width(Class ~ px(150)) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(13))
```

## <span class="en">Checking the tool before trusting it</span><span class="zh">在信任工具之前先检验它</span> {#sec-ehsa-check}

::: {.en}
`emerging_hotspot_analysis()` in sfdep [@parry2023] runs the whole procedure
in one call. Before its output was interpreted, its space-time Gi\* was
reimplemented independently (`gi_spt()` in `R/ehsa.R`) and the two compared
value by value. The deterministic part agrees: the largest difference
between the two sets of `r n_fmt(EH$cube_info$n_bins)` Gi\* values is
`r format(EH$validation$max_gi_diff, digits = 2)`, rounding error. The
comparison nonetheless exposed three defects in how the function uses that
statistic, and a fourth issue in how its output is usually read.
:::

::: {.zh}
sfdep 的 `emerging_hotspot_analysis()` [@parry2023] 一次调用就完成全部流程。在解读其
输出之前,本研究独立重新实现了它的时空 Gi\*(`R/ehsa.R` 中的 `gi_spt()`),并逐值
比较二者。确定性部分是一致的:两组 `r n_fmt(EH$cube_info$n_bins)` 个 Gi\* 值之间的
最大差异是 `r format(EH$validation$max_gi_diff, digits = 2)`,只是舍入误差。尽管如此,
这一比较还是揭示了该函数在**使用**这一统计量时的三个缺陷,以及其输出在通常解读方式
上的第四个问题。
:::

### <span class="en">Defect 1: results attached to the wrong township</span><span class="zh">缺陷一:结果被贴到错误的镇区上</span>

::: {.en}
The function computes each township's classification by splitting the
results by location, which orders them alphabetically by location
identifier, and then labels the rows with the locations *in the order of the
geometry*. When the two orders differ, every result is attached to some
other township. The cube was built twice, identical except for the order of
the polygons: once sorted by `TS_PCODE`, once in the order MIMU delivers
them. The Mann-Kendall tau that the function reports was then compared with
tau computed directly from each township's own Gi\* series.
:::

::: {.zh}
该函数在计算每个镇区的分类时,先按地点拆分结果,这会使结果按地点标识符的**字母顺序**
排列;然后又按**几何对象的顺序**给各行贴上地点标签。只要两种顺序不同,每个结果就会被
贴到另一个镇区上。本研究构建了两次立方体,除多边形顺序外完全相同:一次按 `TS_PCODE`
排序,一次按 MIMU 交付时的顺序。然后把函数报告的 Mann-Kendall tau 与直接由每个镇区
**自身** Gi\* 序列计算的 tau 相比较。
:::

```{r}
#| label: fig-labelbug
#| fig-cap: "<span class='en'>Mann-Kendall tau reported by sfdep's emerging_hotspot_analysis() against tau computed from each township's own Gi\\* series. Left: geometry sorted by location identifier. Right: geometry in MIMU's delivered order.</span><span class='zh'>sfdep 的 emerging_hotspot_analysis() 报告的 Mann-Kendall tau,与由各镇区自身 Gi\\* 序列计算的 tau 对比。左:几何对象按地点标识符排序。右:几何对象按 MIMU 交付时的顺序。</span>"
#| fig-alt: "Two scatterplots. With sorted geometry every point lies on the diagonal; with MIMU order the points form a structureless cloud."
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4.2

tau_true <- tibble(location = EH$locs,
                   tau_me = apply(EH$results$conflict$G, 1,
                                  function(g) Kendall::MannKendall(g)$tau))
lb <- bind_rows(
  tau_true |> mutate(tau_sf = tau_me, panel = "Geometry sorted by TS_PCODE"),
  EH$validation$tau_mimu |> mutate(panel = "Geometry in MIMU's order")
) |>
  mutate(panel = factor(panel, levels = c("Geometry sorted by TS_PCODE",
                                          "Geometry in MIMU's order")))
ggplot(lb, aes(tau_me, tau_sf)) +
  geom_abline(colour = "#a8a29e", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.6, colour = PAL$conflict) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(title = "Same data, same statistic, different polygon order",
       x = "tau from the township's own Gi* series",
       y = "tau reported by emerging_hotspot_analysis()") +
  theme_th(10.5)
```

::: {.interp .en}
**Label defect.** With sorted geometry the reported tau is exactly right for
every township (largest difference
`r EH$validation$max_tau_diff_sorted`). With MIMU's order,
`r pct(100 * EH$validation$share_wrong_mimu)` of townships receive another
township's tau, and the correlation between reported and true values is
`r sprintf("%.2f", EH$validation$cor_tau_mimu)`. Relabelling the rows in
alphabetical order of location recovers the right answer exactly, which
pins the cause on the labelling step. `r EH$validation$class_changed_mimu`
of `r N_TS` classifications change. Nothing in the output signals the
problem: every township gets a plausible class, and the map looks like a
map. The same pattern, a tau unrelated to a hand computation, is what one
would see on any dataset whose polygons are not stored in sorted order. This
analysis avoids it by sorting the frame (@sec-prep-islands) and by checking
the labels.
:::

::: {.interp .zh}
**标签缺陷。** 几何对象排序时,报告的 tau 对每个镇区都完全正确(最大差异
`r EH$validation$max_tau_diff_sorted`)。按 MIMU 的顺序时,
`r pct(100 * EH$validation$share_wrong_mimu)` 的镇区得到的是另一个镇区的 tau,报告值
与真实值的相关系数为 `r sprintf("%.2f", EH$validation$cor_tau_mimu)`。把各行按地点的
字母顺序重新贴标签,就能完全恢复正确答案,这把原因锁定在贴标签这一步。`r N_TS` 个
分类中有 `r EH$validation$class_changed_mimu` 个发生变化。输出中没有任何迹象提示这个
问题:每个镇区都得到一个看似合理的类别,地图看起来也像一张正常的地图。任何多边形
不是按排序存储的数据集,都会出现同样的现象,即 tau 与手工计算毫无关系。本分析通过对
分析框架排序(@sec-prep-islands)并核对标签来避免它。
:::

### <span class="en">Defect 2: a null model that pools every quarter</span><span class="zh">缺陷二:把所有季度混在一起的零模型</span>

::: {.en}
The function judges significance by conditional permutation, but the
pseudo-neighbours are drawn from *every bin of the cube*: any township, in
any quarter, including the township's own slot. Gi\* is standardised by the
quarter's own mean and variance, so when the national level trends, the
draws for a quiet quarter come mostly from busier quarters, and almost every
township in it looks unusually low. In a busy quarter the reverse happens.
The replacement, `gi_spt_perm()` in `R/ehsa.R`, holds the township's own
values fixed and replaces its neighbours with a random set of other
townships, read *in the same quarters* as the real neighbours. Everything
else (statistic, threshold, classification rules apart from the one in
Defect 3) is left exactly as in sfdep; feeding sfdep's own p-values through
the replacement classifier with sfdep's rules unchanged reproduces sfdep's
classes exactly (`r EH$validation$classifier_identical`).
:::

::: {.zh}
该函数以条件置换判断显著性,但伪邻居是从**立方体的每一个格元**中抽取的:任何镇区、
任何季度,甚至包括该镇区自身的位置。Gi\* 是按该季度自身的均值与方差标准化的,所以当
全国水平存在趋势时,为一个平静季度抽取的样本大多来自更繁忙的季度,于是该季度几乎
每个镇区都显得异常地低;繁忙季度则恰好相反。替代方案 `R/ehsa.R` 中的 `gi_spt_perm()`
固定镇区自身的值,用一组随机的其他镇区替换其邻居,并在与真实邻居**相同的季度**读取
它们的值。其余一切(统计量、阈值,以及除缺陷三所涉规则之外的分类规则)都与 sfdep
完全相同;把 sfdep 自己的 p 值输入替代分类器、并保持 sfdep 规则不变,可以完全复现
sfdep 的分类(`r EH$validation$classifier_identical`)。
:::

```{r}
#| label: ehsa-perm-code
#| eval: false
# Inside gi_spt_perm(): for quarter t and township i
S   <- rowSums(X[, max(1, t - k):t, drop = FALSE])    # same quarters as the real neighbours
obs <- sum(S[nb_self[[i]]])                           # own value + real neighbours
r   <- matrix(replicate(nsim, sample.int(n - 1L, ci)), nrow = ci)
idx <- r + (r >= i)                                    # any township except i itself
sim <- S[i] + colSums(matrix(S[idx], nrow = ci))       # own value fixed + random neighbours
p_fold[i, t] <- min((sum(obs >= sim) + 1) / (nsim + 1),
                    (sum(obs <= sim) + 1) / (nsim + 1))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-nulls
#| fig-cap: "<span class='en'>Townships that are significant hot or cold spots in each quarter, all conflict events, under sfdep's pooled null and under the period-conditional null. Grey bars: national conflict events in the quarter (right axis).</span><span class='zh'>每个季度显著热点与冷点的镇区数(全部冲突事件),分别基于 sfdep 的混合零模型与按期条件化的零模型。灰色柱:该季度全国冲突事件数(右轴)。</span>"
#| fig-alt: "Line chart in which sfdep's pooled null marks almost 190 townships as cold spots in 2021 Q1 while the period-conditional null marks about 10; hot spots under the pooled null track the national trend."
#| fig-width: 9.6
#| fig-height: 4.6

bn <- EH$bins_by_null |>
  pivot_longer(c(hot, cold), names_to = "side", values_to = "n") |>
  mutate(side = recode(side, hot = "Hot spots", cold = "Cold spots"))
sc <- max(bn$n) / max(bn$national)
ggplot(bn, aes(period + 45)) +
  geom_col(data = distinct(bn, period, national), aes(y = national * sc),
           fill = "#e7e5e4", width = 80) +
  geom_line(aes(y = n, colour = null), linewidth = 0.85) +
  geom_point(aes(y = n, colour = null), size = 1.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ side) +
  scale_colour_manual(NULL, values = c("sfdep: pooled over all quarters" = "#a8a29e",
                                       "Period-conditional" = PAL$conflict)) +
  scale_y_continuous("Significant townships",
                     sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / sc, name = "National events",
                                         labels = label_comma())) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  labs(title = "Under the pooled null, significance follows the national trend",
       x = NULL) +
  theme_th(10.5)
```

```{r}
#| label: null-numbers
#| include: false
bq1 <- EH$bins_by_null |> filter(period == min(period))
sf_q1_cold <- bq1$cold[grepl("sfdep", bq1$null)]
pc_q1_cold <- bq1$cold[!grepl("sfdep", bq1$null)]
cor_sf <- with(EH$bins_by_null |> filter(grepl("sfdep", null)), cor(hot, national))
cor_pc <- with(EH$bins_by_null |> filter(!grepl("sfdep", null)), cor(hot, national))
hot_sf <- EH$bins_by_null$hot[grepl("sfdep", EH$bins_by_null$null)]
hot_pc <- EH$bins_by_null$hot[!grepl("sfdep", EH$bins_by_null$null)]
```

::: {.interp .en}
**Null defect.** In the first quarter of 2021, when only
`r n_fmt(bq1$national[1])` conflict events were recorded nationally, the
pooled null marks `r sf_q1_cold` of `r N_TS` townships as significant cold
spots. The period-conditional null marks `r pc_q1_cold`. Under the pooled
null the number of hot spots swings from `r min(hot_sf)` to `r max(hot_sf)`
across the quarters and tracks the national total closely (correlation
`r sprintf("%.2f", cor_sf)`); under the period-conditional null it stays
between `r min(hot_pc)` and `r max(hot_pc)`, moving with how clustered the
conflict is in a quarter rather than with how much of it there is. The pooled
null therefore converts the national escalation into local significance:
early quarters are full of spurious cold spots and later quarters of extra
hot spots. That sequence, cold first and hot later, is precisely the definition
of an *oscillating hot spot*, which is why the uncorrected output is full of
them.
:::

::: {.interp .zh}
**零模型缺陷。** 2021 年第一季度,全国只记录到 `r n_fmt(bq1$national[1])` 起冲突事件,
而混合零模型把 `r N_TS` 个镇区中的 `r sf_q1_cold` 个标为显著冷点;按期条件化的零模型
只标出 `r pc_q1_cold` 个。在混合零模型下,各季度的热点数在 `r min(hot_sf)` 到
`r max(hot_sf)` 之间大幅摆动,并紧随全国总量(相关系数 `r sprintf("%.2f", cor_sf)`);在
按期条件化的零模型下,它保持在 `r min(hot_pc)` 到 `r max(hot_pc)` 之间,随的是该季度冲突
的聚集程度,而不是冲突的多少。因此混合零模型把全国性的升级转化成了局部显著性:早期
季度充满虚假冷点,后期季度则多出热点。「先冷后热」这个序列,恰恰就是**振荡热点**的
定义,这正是未修正输出中振荡热点泛滥的原因。
:::

```{r}
#| label: tbl-sfdep-vs-pc
#| tbl-cap: "<span class='en'>Townships in each class, sfdep's pooled null against the period-conditional null, for all five variables. Only classes that occur in either are shown.</span><span class='zh'>五个变量在 sfdep 混合零模型与按期条件化零模型下各类别的镇区数。只列出在任一方案中出现的类别。</span>"

cmp_tbl <- bind_rows(
  EH$sfdep_all |> mutate(null = "sfdep") |> select(var, null, cls = classification),
  map_dfr(names(VARS), function(v) tibble(var = v, null = "corrected",
                                          cls = cls_of(v)))
) |>
  mutate(var = VAR_SHORT[var]) |>
  count(var, null, cls) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(var, null), values_from = n, values_fill = 0,
              names_sep = "|") |>
  arrange(cls) |>
  mutate(cls = as.character(cls))

col_order <- as.vector(t(outer(unname(VAR_SHORT), c("sfdep", "corrected"),
                               function(a, b) paste(a, b, sep = "|"))))
cmp_tbl |>
  select(cls, any_of(col_order)) |>
  gt(rowname_col = "cls") |>
  tab_spanner_delim(delim = "|") |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(12))
```

::: {.interp .en}
**Consequence.** For all conflict events, sfdep classifies
`r sum(EH$cls_compare$sfdep == "Oscillating hot spot")` townships as
oscillating hot spots; the period-conditional null leaves
`r sum(EH$cls_compare$pc == "Oscillating hot spot")`. Most of the others
become sporadic or consecutive hot spots, which is what the heat strip in
@fig-cube suggests they are: townships that have been violent relative to the
rest of the country for most of the period, not townships that were once
unusually calm. The persistent cold spots fall from
`r sum(EH$cls_compare$sfdep == "Persistent cold spot")` to
`r sum(EH$cls_compare$pc == "Persistent cold spot")`, because quiet
townships in the quiet early quarters are no longer counted as significant.
The same shift appears in all five variables.
:::

::: {.interp .zh}
**后果。** 就全部冲突事件而言,sfdep 把 `r sum(EH$cls_compare$sfdep == "Oscillating hot spot")`
个镇区归为振荡热点;按期条件化的零模型只剩 `r sum(EH$cls_compare$pc == "Oscillating hot spot")`
个。其余大多变为零星或连续热点,而这正是 @fig-cube 中的热力条带所提示的:它们是在
研究期大部分时间里相对于全国其他地区一直暴力的镇区,而不是曾经异常平静的镇区。持续
冷点从 `r sum(EH$cls_compare$sfdep == "Persistent cold spot")` 个降到
`r sum(EH$cls_compare$pc == "Persistent cold spot")` 个,因为平静早期季度中的平静镇区
不再被算作显著。同样的变化出现在全部五个变量中。
:::

### <span class="en">Defect 3: a class rule that ignores the sign</span><span class="zh">缺陷三:一条忽略符号的分类规则</span>

::: {.en}
sfdep tests a township against its class rules in a fixed order and assigns
the first that fits. Its rule for an *intensifying hot spot* asks for
significance in at least 90% of quarters, including the last, and a
significant upward trend, but it counts significant quarters of either sign
and never checks that they are hot. It is also tested before the rule for a
*diminishing cold spot*. A township that is a significant cold spot almost
throughout, and whose Gi\* is rising towards zero, is therefore called an
intensifying hot spot. The cold version of the rule already counts only cold
quarters, so the hot version is corrected to match (`ehsa_rules()` in
`R/ehsa.R`), and nothing else in the rule set is changed.
:::

::: {.zh}
sfdep 按固定顺序用各条分类规则检验一个镇区,并赋予第一个符合的类别。它对**增强热点**
的规则要求包括最后一个季度在内至少 90% 的季度显著,且有显著的上升趋势;但它统计的是
**任一符号**的显著季度,从不检查这些季度是否为**热**。而且这条规则排在**减弱冷点**
规则之前。因此,一个几乎始终是显著冷点、且 Gi\* 正向零回升的镇区,会被称为增强热点。
冷点版本的规则本来就只统计冷季度,所以本研究把热点版本修正为与之一致(`R/ehsa.R` 中的
`ehsa_rules()`),规则集的其余部分不作任何改动。
:::

```{r}
#| label: tbl-rulefix
#| tbl-cap: "<span class='en'>Townships whose class changes when the intensifying hot spot rule is corrected, all five variables, period-conditional null.</span><span class='zh'>修正增强热点规则后类别发生变化的镇区(全部五个变量,按期条件化零模型)。</span>"

EH$rule_fix |>
  left_join(st_drop_geometry(ts_an)[, c("TS_PCODE", "TS", "ST")], by = "TS_PCODE") |>
  transmute(Township = TS, State = ST, Variable = VAR_SHORT[var],
            `sfdep's rule` = ehsa_label(sfdep_rule), Corrected = ehsa_label(corrected),
            `Significant hot quarters` = n_hot, `Significant cold quarters` = n_cold) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(13))
```

::: {.interp .en}
**Rule defect.** The defect is rare in these data, but where it occurs the
label is the opposite of the truth: Mongyang, in the eastern Shan hills, is a
significant cold spot of remote violence in 18 of 19 quarters and was
labelled an intensifying hot spot. A reader who mapped "intensifying hot
spots" as early warnings would have flagged one of the quietest townships in
the country.
:::

::: {.interp .zh}
**规则缺陷。** 这个缺陷在本数据中很少出现,但一旦出现,标签就与事实正好相反:掸邦
东部山地的勐央,在 19 个季度中有 18 个季度是远程暴力的显著冷点,却被标为增强热点。
如果读者把「增强热点」当作预警来绘图,就会把全国最平静的镇区之一标记出来。
:::

### <span class="en">A fourth issue: how many classes would chance produce?</span><span class="zh">第四个问题:偶然会产生多少类别?</span> {#sec-ehsa-null}

::: {.en}
The fourth issue is not a defect in code but in how EHSA output is usually
read. Each township is tested `r EH$cube_info$n_times` times, and a single
significant hot quarter with no significant cold one is enough to make a
township a "sporadic hot spot". At a threshold that is two-sided 0.10 in
effect, that will happen often by chance alone. To see how often, each
township's complete 19-quarter history was moved to a random location,
keeping every series and its serial dependence intact and destroying only
the spatial arrangement, and the whole analysis was re-run
`r EH$nnull` times.
:::

::: {.zh}
第四个问题不是代码缺陷,而在于 EHSA 输出通常的解读方式。每个镇区要被检验
`r EH$cube_info$n_times` 次,只要有一个显著热季度而没有显著冷季度,就足以使其成为
「零星热点」。在实际相当于双侧 0.10 的阈值下,这种情况单凭偶然就会经常发生。为了
知道有多常发生,本研究把每个镇区完整的 19 个季度历史随机移到另一个位置,保持每条
序列及其序列相关不变,只破坏空间排列,然后把整个分析重复 `r EH$nnull` 次。
:::

```{r}
#| label: fig-ehsa-null
#| fig-cap: "<span class='en'>Observed number of townships in each class (red) against the range produced by 99 cubes in which township histories were relocated at random (grey bar: 95% interval; grey point: mean). All conflict events.</span><span class='zh'>各类别的观测镇区数(红色),与 99 个随机迁移镇区历史的立方体所产生的范围对比(灰条:95% 区间;灰点:均值)。全部冲突事件。</span>"
#| fig-alt: "Dot and interval chart. Sporadic hot spots lie just above the chance range; consecutive and persistent cold spots lie far above it; no pattern detected lies far below."
#| fig-width: 8.6
#| fig-height: 4.4

EH$null_classes |>
  mutate(class = fct_rev(class)) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = class)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = null_lo, xmax = null_hi), colour = "#a8a29e", linewidth = 3.2) +
  geom_point(aes(x = null_mean), colour = "#57534e", size = 1.8) +
  geom_point(aes(x = observed), colour = PAL$conflict, size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(x = pmax(observed, null_hi), label = observed), colour = PAL$conflict,
            hjust = 0, nudge_x = 4, size = 3.1) +
  labs(title = "How many townships each class would hold by chance",
       subtitle = "Red: observed. Grey: 95% range when township histories are placed at random",
       x = "Townships", y = NULL) +
  theme_th(10.5)
```

::: {.interp .en}
**Chance.** With no spatial structure at all, about
`r round(EH$null_classes$null_mean[EH$null_classes$class == "Sporadic hot spot"])`
townships would still be classed as sporadic hot spots; the observed
`r ncls(ec, "Sporadic hot spot")` is barely above that. The sporadic hot
class *as a whole* is therefore weak evidence, and a township's label alone
says little. What separates a real hot spot from a chance one is how many
quarters it spent hot: under the null, fewer than 1% of townships reach
`r k_star` or more significant hot quarters. The cold side is the opposite:
`r ncls(ec, "Consecutive cold spot")` consecutive and
`r ncls(ec, "Persistent cold spot")` persistent cold spots against fewer than
`r ceiling(EH$null_classes$null_hi[EH$null_classes$class == "Consecutive cold spot"])`
and 1 by chance. And the
`r ncls(ec, "No pattern detected")` townships with no pattern are half the
chance expectation, because real spatial structure leaves few townships
untouched. @fig-ehsa-main therefore maps the number of significant quarters
alongside the class.
:::

::: {.interp .zh}
**偶然。** 即使完全没有空间结构,也仍会有约
`r round(EH$null_classes$null_mean[EH$null_classes$class == "Sporadic hot spot"])`
个镇区被归为零星热点;观测到的 `r ncls(ec, "Sporadic hot spot")` 个只是略高于此。
因此,零星热点这个类别**整体**只是弱证据,单看一个镇区的标签说明不了什么。真正把
真实热点与偶然热点区分开的,是它处于热点状态的**季度数**:在零模型下,只有不到 1% 的
镇区能达到 `r k_star` 个或以上的显著热季度。冷的一侧正好相反:观测到
`r ncls(ec, "Consecutive cold spot")` 个连续冷点与 `r ncls(ec, "Persistent cold spot")`
个持续冷点,而偶然情况下分别不到
`r ceiling(EH$null_classes$null_hi[EH$null_classes$class == "Consecutive cold spot"])`
个与 1 个。`r ncls(ec, "No pattern detected")` 个无模式镇区只有偶然期望的一半,因为
真实的空间结构使很少有镇区不受触及。因此 @fig-ehsa-main 在类别旁边同时绘制显著季度数。
:::

## <span class="en">Results</span><span class="zh">结果</span> {#sec-ehsa-results}

```{r}
#| label: fig-ehsa-main
#| fig-cap: "<span class='en'>Emerging hot spot analysis of all conflict events, period-conditional null. Left: EHSA class; 'no pattern detected' is left blank because it is not a significant result. Right: number of quarters (of 19) in which the township is a significant hot spot (red) or cold spot (blue); the dashed outline marks townships with at least as many hot quarters as fewer than 1% of townships reach by chance.</span><span class='zh'>全部冲突事件的新兴热点分析(按期条件化零模型)。左:EHSA 类别;「未检测到模式」不是显著结果,因此留白。右:镇区在 19 个季度中作为显著热点(红)或冷点(蓝)的季度数;虚线描边标出显著热季度数达到偶然情况下不到 1% 的镇区所能达到水平的镇区。</span>"
#| fig-alt: "Two maps. The class map shows sporadic hot spots over Sagaing, Kachin and the south-east, consecutive hot spots in Magway and Mandalay, and consecutive cold spots in Yangon and eastern Shan. The quarter-count map shows the Dry Zone core as hot in more than 12 quarters."
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 8.6

m_cls <- map_base(
  geom_sf(data = ec_sf |> mutate(cls = replace(cls, cls == "No pattern detected", NA)),
          aes(fill = cls), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.05),
  title = "EHSA class", state_lw = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_manual(NULL, values = PAL_EHSA, na.value = "#fafaf9", drop = TRUE,
                    na.translate = FALSE)

ec_sf <- ec_sf |> mutate(net_q = n_hot - n_cold)
m_q <- map_base(
  list(geom_sf(data = ec_sf, aes(fill = net_q), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.05),
       geom_sf(data = ec_sf |> filter(n_hot >= k_star), fill = NA,
               colour = "#1c1917", linewidth = 0.45, linetype = "22")),
  title = "Quarters as a significant hot (+) or cold (−) spot", state_lw = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(NULL, low = "#08306b", mid = "#fafaf9", high = "#7f0000",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-19, 19))

m_cls + m_q +
  plot_annotation(title = "Emerging hot spots of armed conflict, 2021 Q1 – 2025 Q3",
                  subtitle = "Space-time Gi* (queen + previous quarter), Mann-Kendall, period-conditional permutation null",
                  theme = theme_th(11))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ehsa-counts
#| tbl-cap: "<span class='en'>Townships in each EHSA class, period-conditional null, by variable.</span><span class='zh'>按变量列出的各 EHSA 类别镇区数(按期条件化零模型)。</span>"

map_dfr(names(VARS), function(v) tibble(Variable = VAR_SHORT[[v]], cls = cls_of(v))) |>
  count(Variable, cls) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Variable, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  arrange(cls) |>
  rename(Class = cls) |>
  select(Class, all_of(unname(VAR_SHORT))) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(12.5))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-ehsa-vars
#| fig-cap: "<span class='en'>EHSA classes for the four component variables, period-conditional null. Blank: no pattern detected.</span><span class='zh'>四个分项变量的 EHSA 类别(按期条件化零模型)。空白:未检测到模式。</span>"
#| fig-alt: "Four EHSA maps for battles, remote violence, violence against civilians and fatalities."
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 6.8

# One legend for the four maps: the classes that occur in at least one of them.
present <- map(c("battles", "erv", "vac", "fatalities"), cls_of) |>
  unlist() |> as.character() |> unique()
present <- intersect(setdiff(names(PAL_EHSA), "No pattern detected"), present)

ehsa_map <- function(v) {
  d <- ts_an |> select(TS_PCODE) |>
    left_join(ehsa_df(v), by = "TS_PCODE") |>
    mutate(cls = replace(cls, cls == "No pattern detected", NA))
  map_base(geom_sf(data = d, aes(fill = cls), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.04,
                   show.legend = TRUE),
           title = VAR_TINY[[v]], state_lw = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual("EHSA class", values = PAL_EHSA[present], na.value = "#fafaf9",
                      limits = present, drop = FALSE, na.translate = FALSE) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10.5))
}
wrap_plots(lapply(c("battles", "erv", "vac", "fatalities"), ehsa_map), nrow = 1) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 3)) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.key.height = unit(0.35, "cm"),
        legend.key.width = unit(0.5, "cm"))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-ehsa-traj
#| fig-cap: "<span class='en'>What the classes look like over time: each township's Gi\\* series (thin lines) and the median of its class (thick line), all conflict events. The dashed lines mark Gi\\* = ±1.96 for orientation; significance itself is by permutation.</span><span class='zh'>各类别随时间的样子:每个镇区的 Gi\\* 序列(细线)与其类别的中位数(粗线),全部冲突事件。虚线标出 Gi\\* = ±1.96 作为参照;显著性本身由置换判定。</span>"
#| fig-alt: "Small multiples of Gi* time series by EHSA class. Consecutive hot spots rise into sustained high values; consecutive cold spots drift steadily negative."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

G <- EH$results$conflict$G
traj <- tibble(TS_PCODE = rep(EH$locs, times = ncol(G)),
               period = rep(quarters, each = nrow(G)),
               gi = as.vector(G)) |>
  left_join(ec |> select(TS_PCODE, cls), by = "TS_PCODE") |>
  filter(cls != "No pattern detected")
med <- traj |> group_by(cls, period) |> summarise(gi = median(gi), .groups = "drop")
ggplot(traj, aes(period, gi)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-1.96, 1.96), linetype = "22", colour = "#a8a29e", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_line(aes(group = TS_PCODE, colour = cls), alpha = 0.18, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_line(data = med, aes(colour = cls), linewidth = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ cls, nrow = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = PAL_EHSA, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  labs(title = "Gi* trajectories by EHSA class", x = NULL, y = "Gi*") +
  theme_th(10)
```

## <span class="en">Reading the clusters</span><span class="zh">解读各类聚集</span> {#sec-ehsa-clusters}

```{r}
#| label: ehsa-cluster-numbers
#| include: false
run_start <- function(v) {
  r <- EH$results[[v]]
  sig_hot <- r$p_fold <= EH$alpha & r$G > 0
  vapply(seq_len(nrow(sig_hot)), function(i) {
    s <- sig_hot[i, ]
    if (!s[length(s)]) return(NA_integer_)
    rl <- rle(rev(s)); length(s) - rl$lengths[1] + 1L
  }, integer(1))
}
emerging <- map_dfr(names(VARS), function(v) {
  d <- ehsa_df(v)
  d$start <- run_start(v)
  d |> filter(cls %in% c("New hot spot", "Consecutive hot spot",
                         "Intensifying hot spot", "Oscillating hot spot")) |>
    mutate(var = v)
}) |>
  left_join(st_drop_geometry(ts_an)[, c("TS_PCODE", "TS", "ST")], by = "TS_PCODE")

cons_c   <- ec |> filter(cls == "Consecutive hot spot")
spor_c   <- ec |> filter(cls == "Sporadic hot spot")
chronic  <- spor_c |> filter(n_hot >= k_star)
cold_c   <- ec |> filter(cls == "Consecutive cold spot")
pers_c   <- ec |> filter(cls == "Persistent cold spot")
spcold_c <- ec |> filter(cls == "Sporadic cold spot")
nop_c    <- ec |> filter(cls == "No pattern detected")
top_st <- function(d, n = 3) d |> count(ST, sort = TRUE) |> head(n) |>
  mutate(s = paste0(ST, " (", n, ")")) |> pull(s) |> paste(collapse = ", ")

# Townships that a two-sided threshold moves into "no pattern".
two <- ehsa_label(EH$results$conflict$cls_two$classification)
mv_idx <- which(two == "No pattern detected" & ec$cls != "No pattern detected")
mv <- list(n = length(mv_idx),
           spor = sum(grepl("Sporadic", ec$cls[mv_idx])),
           q12 = sum(pmax(ec$n_hot, ec$n_cold)[mv_idx] <= 2))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-emerging
#| tbl-cap: "<span class='en'>Townships classed as new, consecutive, intensifying or oscillating hot spots for any variable, with the quarter in which their final run of significant hot quarters began.</span><span class='zh'>在任一变量上被归为新出现、连续、增强或振荡热点的镇区,以及其最后一段连续显著热季度开始的季度。</span>"

emerging |>
  mutate(Variable = VAR_SHORT[var], `Run began` = q_lab(quarters[start]),
         `Quarters in run` = length(quarters) - start + 1L) |>
  arrange(start, ST, TS) |>
  select(Township = TS, State = ST, Variable, Class = cls, `Run began`, `Quarters in run`) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(12), container.height = px(420))
```

::: {.en}
The descriptions below follow the classes of @fig-ehsa-main for all conflict
events, drawing on the component variables where they differ. Each is kept
within 250 words.
:::

::: {.zh}
以下描述按 @fig-ehsa-main 中全部冲突事件的类别展开,在分项变量有差别时加以引用。
每段不超过 250 词。
:::

::: {.interp .en}
**Consecutive hot spots (`r nrow(cons_c)`).** These are townships that
became significant hot spots and have stayed hot every quarter since. They
fall into two groups. The first is the old core of the Dry Zone, across the
Sagaing, Magway and Mandalay borders: Myaing, Pakokku, Yesagyo, Salingyi and Singu turned hot in late 2021
and have been hot in `r min(cons_c$n_hot[cons_c$n_hot > 10])` or more of the
19 quarters, which is chronic rather than emerging; they miss the
"persistent" class only because it requires 90% of quarters. The second
group is genuinely new. Chauk and Nyaung-U, on the Ayeyarwady south of the
core, have been hot only in the last two quarters, and Pyinoolwin and
Kyaukme, on the Mandalay–Lashio road into northern Shan, since mid-2024.
@tbl-emerging shows the same direction across variables: the newest runs are
in the south and east of the Dry Zone (Meiktila, Kyaukpadaung, Mahlaing and
Yenangyaung for violence against civilians, Natogyi for fatalities, Kyaukse
for battles), in western Bago and in Mon. **The front has been moving south
and east, out of the Sagaing plains towards central Myanmar and the roads to
Mandalay.** These are the townships where conflict is newest and most likely
to deepen.
:::

::: {.interp .zh}
**连续热点(`r nrow(cons_c)` 个)。** 这些镇区成为显著热点之后,每个季度都一直保持
热点状态。它们分为两组。第一组是横跨实皆、马圭与曼德勒交界的干燥带老核心:敏建、木各具、耶沙久、
沙林基与新古在 2021 年底转热,在 19 个季度中有 `r min(cons_c$n_hot[cons_c$n_hot > 10])`
个或更多季度是热点,与其说是「新兴」不如说是**长期**的;它们只是因为「持续」类别要求
90% 的季度,才没有被归入该类。第二组才是真正的新热点:伊洛瓦底江畔、核心以南的稍埠
与良乌只在最近两个季度成为热点,通往掸邦北部的曼德勒–腊戍公路沿线的眉谬与皎梅则从
2024 年中开始。@tbl-emerging 显示各变量呈现同一方向:最新的连续热点段出现在干燥带的
南部与东部(针对平民暴力的密铁拉、皎勃东、马莱与仁安羌,死亡人数的纳托吉,战斗的
皎施),以及勃固西部与孟邦。**前线一直在向南、向东移动,
从实皆平原移向缅甸中部与通往曼德勒的道路。** 这些是冲突最新、也最可能加深的镇区。
:::

::: {.interp .en}
**Sporadic hot spots (`r nrow(spor_c)`).** This is the largest hot class and
the least informative as a label, since chance alone would produce about
`r round(EH$null_classes$null_mean[EH$null_classes$class == "Sporadic hot spot"])`
of them. The count of significant quarters separates two kinds.
`r nrow(chronic)` sporadic hot spots were hot in `r k_star` or more quarters,
beyond what chance produces; they are chronic hot spots whose run was broken
by one or two quieter quarters, among them Monywa, the township with the most
conflict events in the country. They are concentrated in Sagaing
(`r sum(chronic$ST == "Sagaing")`) and form the body of the Dry Zone cluster
found by local Moran's I. The remaining
`r nrow(spor_c) - nrow(chronic)` were hot in fewer quarters; most are in
northern Shan, the outer townships of Sagaing, Kachin, Chin, Tanintharyi,
Rakhine and Kayah, where conflict came in episodes: an offensive, a lull,
another offensive. For these, a single
hot quarter should not be over-read, but the episodes are real enough on the
ground, and the Markov analysis in @sec-va shows that each one raises the
risk next door.
:::

::: {.interp .zh}
**零星热点(`r nrow(spor_c)` 个)。** 这是最大的热点类别,作为标签却最缺乏信息量,因为
单凭偶然就会产生约
`r round(EH$null_classes$null_mean[EH$null_classes$class == "Sporadic hot spot"])` 个。
显著季度数把它们分成两类。有 `r nrow(chronic)` 个零星热点在 `r k_star` 个或以上季度
处于热点状态,超出偶然所能产生的程度;它们是**长期热点**,只是其连续段被一两个较平静
的季度打断,其中包括全国冲突事件最多的镇区蒙育瓦。它们集中在实皆
(`r sum(chronic$ST == "Sagaing")` 个),构成局部 Moran's I 所发现的干燥带聚集的主体。
其余 `r nrow(spor_c) - nrow(chronic)` 个处于热点状态的季度较少,大多位于掸邦北部、
实皆外围镇区、克钦、钦邦、德林达依、若开与克耶,那里的冲突是**阵发式**的:一次攻势、
一段平静、再一次攻势。对这些镇区,单个热季度不应被过度解读;但这些阵发在地面上是真实的,
@sec-va 的马尔可夫分析表明,每一次都会提高隔壁的风险。
:::

::: {.interp .en}
**New, intensifying and oscillating hot spots.** These classes are almost
empty once the null is corrected. For all conflict events there are
`r ncls(ec, "New hot spot")` new, `r ncls(ec, "Intensifying hot spot")`
intensifying and `r ncls(ec, "Oscillating hot spot")` oscillating hot spots.
The oscillating ones are informative: Ramree, in Rakhine, was a significant
cold spot in 2021–2022 and has been a hot spot in every quarter of 2025 (for
battles, since late 2024), as the fighting in Rakhine moved south down the
coast; Lawksawk, in southern Shan, was cold in 2023 and hot again in late
2024 and in the latest quarter. Among the component variables, a single new hot spot of battles at
Bokpyin in the far south of Tanintharyi, and a new hot spot of violence
against civilians at Sidoktaya in Magway, mark places where the latest
quarter broke with the past, and Taungtha, south of Myingyan, is the one
genuine intensifying hot spot: hot for violence against civilians in 18 of
19 quarters, with a rising trend. The near-absence of these classes is itself
a finding: in this conflict, hot spots rarely appear from nowhere, which
agrees with the onset analysis in @sec-va-onset.
:::

::: {.interp .zh}
**新出现、增强与振荡热点。** 修正零模型之后,这几个类别几乎是空的。就全部冲突事件
而言,新出现热点 `r ncls(ec, "New hot spot")` 个、增强热点 `r ncls(ec, "Intensifying hot spot")`
个、振荡热点 `r ncls(ec, "Oscillating hot spot")` 个。振荡热点是有信息量的:若开的兰里
在 2021–2022 年是显著冷点,而在 2025 年的每个季度都是热点(战斗方面自 2024 年底起),
因为若开的战事沿海岸向南推进;掸邦南部的罗索在 2023 年是冷点,在 2024 年底与最近一个季度再度转热。
在分项变量中,德林达依最南端博克平的一个战斗新热点,以及马圭锡多达亚的一个针对平民
暴力的新热点,标出了最近一个季度与过去决裂的地方;敏建以南的当达是唯一真正的增强
热点:在 19 个季度中有 18 个季度是针对平民暴力的热点,且趋势上升。这些类别几乎为空,
这本身就是一个发现:在这场冲突中,热点很少凭空出现,这与 @sec-va-onset 的爆发分析
一致。
:::

::: {.interp .en}
**Consecutive and persistent cold spots (`r nrow(cold_c)` and
`r nrow(pers_c)`).** The cold side of the map is far more structured than
chance. The persistent cold spots are Kengtung, Mongyang and Mongping in
eastern Shan, and Narphan and Mongmao in the Wa self-administered area:
significant cold spots in 18 or 19 of 19 quarters. The consecutive cold spots
are two groups with different histories.
`r sum(grepl("Shan", cold_c$ST))` are in the same eastern and southern Shan
hills and the Wa area, cold almost throughout.
`r sum(cold_c$ST == "Yangon")` are in Yangon, and their tau is negative:
Yangon was not a cold spot in 2021, when urban bombings and the crackdown
kept it active, and its townships turned cold one after another from the
second half of 2022. For the eastern Shan hills the cold reflects a region largely
outside the war, under armed groups that stayed out of it, though thin
reporting may contribute (@sec-assump). For Yangon it reflects the
suppression of the urban resistance, not the absence of the state's
violence.
:::

::: {.interp .zh}
**连续冷点与持续冷点(`r nrow(cold_c)` 个与 `r nrow(pers_c)` 个)。** 地图冷的一侧远比
偶然情况更有结构。持续冷点是掸邦东部的景栋、勐央与勐平,以及佤自治区的纳潘与勐冒:
它们在 19 个季度中有 18 或 19 个季度是显著冷点。连续冷点是历史不同的两组。有 `r sum(grepl("Shan", cold_c$ST))` 个
位于同一片掸邦东部与南部山地以及佤地区,几乎始终是冷点。另有 `r sum(cold_c$ST == "Yangon")`
个在仰光,而它们的 tau 为负:2021 年仰光并不是冷点,当时城市爆炸袭击与镇压使其保持
活跃;从 2022 年下半年起,其各镇区相继转为冷点。对掸邦东部山地而言,冷意味着一个基本处于战争之外、由置身事外的
武装团体控制的区域,尽管报道稀少也可能有影响(@sec-assump)。对仰光而言,冷反映的是
城市抵抗力量**被镇压**,而不是国家暴力的缺席。
:::

::: {.interp .en}
**Sporadic cold spots (`r nrow(spcold_c)`) and no pattern
(`r nrow(nop_c)`).** Sporadic cold spots are led by
`r top_st(spcold_c, 4)`. They are townships that have been significantly quiet
relative to the country in some quarters, most of them in the delta, around
Yangon, in southern Shan and in the south of Magway and western Bago. The
last two deserve attention: they were significantly quiet in 2021–2023, and
since 2024 @tbl-emerging finds new hot spots of violence against civilians
there (Minhla, Letpadan, Okpho and Monyo in western Bago; Yenangyaung and
Sidoktaya in Magway). A township that was sporadically cold is not
necessarily safe. The `r nrow(nop_c)` townships with no detectable pattern
were never significant in either direction. They are not "average" in a
reassuring sense: they include three of the five townships with the most
conflict events in the country, Kawkareik, Kale and Hpakant, whose
neighbourhoods were never extreme relative to the rest of the country in the
same quarter (@sec-integration).
:::

::: {.interp .zh}
**零星冷点(`r nrow(spcold_c)` 个)与无模式(`r nrow(nop_c)` 个)。** 零星冷点居前的是
`r top_st(spcold_c, 4)`。它们是在某些季度相对于全国显著平静的镇区,大多位于三角洲、
仰光周边、掸邦南部,以及马圭南部与勃固西部。后两者值得注意:它们在 2021–2023
年显著平静,而自 2024 年起 @tbl-emerging 在那里发现了针对平民暴力的新热点(勃固西部的
敏拉、勒巴丹、奥波与茂良;马圭的仁安羌与锡多达亚)。一个曾经零星冷的镇区未必安全。
`r nrow(nop_c)` 个未检测到模式的镇区,在任何方向上都从未显著。它们并不是令人安心意义上
的「一般」:其中包括全国冲突事件最多的五个镇区中的三个,即高加力、葛礼与帕敢,它们的
邻域在同一季度相对于全国其他地区从未极端到显著的程度(@sec-integration)。
:::

## <span class="en">Sensitivity</span><span class="zh">敏感性</span> {#sec-ehsa-sens}

::: {.en}
Each alternative changes one choice relative to the primary run (quarterly
cube, one quarter of time lag, queen contiguity, folded p ≤ 0.05) and counts
how many townships keep the same class, and how many stay on the same side
(hot, cold or neither).
:::

::: {.zh}
每个备选方案都只相对主分析(季度立方体、一个季度的时间滞后、queen 邻接、折叠
p ≤ 0.05)改变一项选择,并统计有多少镇区保持相同类别,以及有多少镇区停留在同一侧
(热、冷或都不是)。
:::

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ehsa-sens
#| tbl-cap: "<span class='en'>Sensitivity of the EHSA classification of all conflict events.</span><span class='zh'>全部冲突事件 EHSA 分类的敏感性。</span>"

EH$sens |>
  mutate(ord = match(spec, c("Primary (quarterly, k = 1, queen, folded p)",
                             "Two-sided p ≤ 0.05", "k = 0 (no time lag)",
                             "k = 2 (two quarters)", "k = 6 nearest neighbours",
                             "Monthly cube (57 months)"))) |>
  arrange(ord) |> select(-ord) |>
  rename(Specification = spec) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(13))
```

::: {.interp .en}
**Sensitivity.** The side a township falls on is robust; the exact class is
less so. Changing the time lag keeps
`r EH$sens$"Hot/cold side kept"[EH$sens$spec == "k = 2 (two quarters)"]` of
`r N_TS` townships on the same side with $k = 2$ and
`r EH$sens$"Hot/cold side kept"[EH$sens$spec == "k = 0 (no time lag)"]` with
$k = 0$. The neighbour definition and the time unit matter more: with six
nearest neighbours or a monthly cube, between a quarter and a third of
townships change class, mostly between sporadic and no pattern at the edges
of the clusters.
Requiring a two-sided p ≤ 0.05 moves `r mv$n` townships into "no pattern";
`r mv$spor` of them were sporadic hot or cold spots, and `r mv$q12` had only
one or two significant quarters, which is the group @sec-ehsa-null already
identified as weak. One assumption deserves a warning. The
Mann-Kendall test assumes independent observations, but with $k = 1$
consecutive Gi\* values share a quarter of data; the median lag-1
autocorrelation of the series is
`r sprintf("%.2f", EH$serial$median_acf1[EH$serial$spec == "k = 1"])`
(`r sprintf("%.2f", EH$serial$median_acf1[EH$serial$spec == "k = 0"])` with
$k = 0$). Positive autocorrelation makes the trend test too liberal
[@hamed1998], so the trend-based classes (intensifying, diminishing) should
be read with caution. Here they are almost empty, so the practical
consequence is small.
:::

::: {.interp .zh}
**敏感性。** 镇区落在哪一侧是稳健的;具体类别则不那么稳健。改变时间滞后时,
$k = 2$ 下 `r N_TS` 个镇区中有
`r EH$sens$"Hot/cold side kept"[EH$sens$spec == "k = 2 (two quarters)"]` 个保持在同一侧,
$k = 0$ 下有 `r EH$sens$"Hot/cold side kept"[EH$sens$spec == "k = 0 (no time lag)"]` 个。
邻居定义与时间单元的影响更大:使用六个最近邻或月度立方体时,四分之一到三分之一的镇区
改变类别,大多是在聚集边缘于零星与无模式之间变动。要求双侧 p ≤ 0.05 会使 `r mv$n` 个镇区转入「无模式」;其中
`r mv$spor` 个原为零星热点或冷点,`r mv$q12` 个只有一两个显著季度,也就是
@sec-ehsa-null 已经判断为弱证据的那一组。有一个假设值得警示:Mann-Kendall 检验假定
观测相互独立,但在 $k = 1$ 时相邻的 Gi\* 值共享一个季度的数据;序列的滞后一阶自相关
中位数为 `r sprintf("%.2f", EH$serial$median_acf1[EH$serial$spec == "k = 1"])`
($k = 0$ 时为 `r sprintf("%.2f", EH$serial$median_acf1[EH$serial$spec == "k = 0"])`)。
正自相关会使趋势检验过于宽松 [@hamed1998],因此基于趋势的类别(增强、减弱)应谨慎
解读。这里它们几乎为空,所以实际影响很小。
:::
